title: "Development"
---

## Tests

The test suite uses Pest and runs on PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5. Tests that use
the `|>` operator are in `tests/Php85`, which `phpunit.xml` loads only on PHP
8.5:

```bash
composer install
php vendor/bin/pest
```

CI runs the suite on Ubuntu with PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5, against PostgreSQL 17
and MySQL 8.0. A second job runs `tests/Polars` on PHP 8.5 with a prebuilt
php_polars extension, and a third runs `composer lint`. CI does not load the
phit extension.

The tests that fit models or use the native CSV reader need the phit extension
and are skipped without it. To run them, load the extension:

```bash
php -d extension=/path/to/libphit.dylib vendor/bin/pest
```

## Comparing with R

Many tests compare phibble with R. Scripts in `tests/r/` run the same
operations in R and write the expected results to `tests/fixtures/`:

| Script | Checks |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/r/print.R` | Printing and `glimpse()` against tibble. |
| `tests/r/io.R` | CSV reading and writing against readr. |
| `tests/r/expr.R` | Expressions against dplyr. |

The fixtures are committed, so the tests do not need R. After changing a
script, regenerate its fixtures from the repository root, for example with
`Rscript tests/r/expr.R`. The scripts need the tibble, readr, dplyr, stringr,
and jsonlite packages.

## Database tests

`tests/SqlTest.php` runs against an in-memory SQLite database. It also runs
against PostgreSQL and MySQL when these environment variables hold PDO DSNs:

```bash
export PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL="pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=postgres"
export PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_USER=postgres
export PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL="mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306"
export PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_USER=root
```

`PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_PASSWORD` and `PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_PASSWORD` set
passwords. The tests only run `SELECT` statements over inline data and create
no tables.

## Documentation

The site is a Quarto project in `docs/`. Every example is a PHP file in
`docs/examples/`. `bin/docs-examples` runs each example with `docs/data` as the
working directory and writes its code and output to
`docs/examples/_<name>.md`, which the pages include. Quarto never runs PHP.

`bin/render-docs` refreshes the examples, renders the site, and copies the
result into `docs/`. Commit the rendered HTML, because phpstats.org imports
it from `docs/` and never runs Quarto:

```bash
PHP=php85 bin/render-docs
```

`bin/docs-examples name` refreshes one example. Set `QUARTO` when the `quarto`
command is not on the path.

`docs/_variables.yml` names the latest release. The data URLs in the docs and
the README point at that tag, and `tests/SiteTest.php` fails until a new
CHANGELOG release is matched there and in the README.

The documentation is published at <https://phibble.phpstats.org/docs>.
GitHub Pages serves only redirects there: the `pages` workflow runs
`bin/pages-redirects`, which writes one redirect page for each page in
`docs/`.
